notes: x/y (and rectX/Y/W/H for glow entries) are pixel coordinates/dimensions on the bundled 256x256 johto_region_map.png, at native scale 8px/MAPSEC-tile with zero offset (pixel = tile*8). This PNG is a from-scratch reconstruction of the real in-game tilemap (johto_region_map.bin + .8bpp + palette at BG_PLTT_ID(7)) - the previously-bundled 128x128 PNG was NOT the real map (naturalistic painted terrain, no road network; didn't match the real schematic HGSS Pokegear map style at all). Every gRegionMapEntries rect lands exactly on its real icon/feature on this reconstruction, with the full 28-wide MAPSEC grid fitting with no sections dropped.

type=glow (towns/routes, real area_glow.png colors) vs type=marker (dungeons/special areas, real area_marker.png sprite) mirrors the real game's own two different indicator systems - see the comment block at the top of src/pokedex_area_screen.c.
A species can have multiple entries (found in multiple areas).
